title: Relationship Review Questions
description: Deterministic review questions for relationship reasoning.

entries.title: Speaker
entries.note: Speaker: Who is speaking?; evidence=Speaker identity | Quotation context

entries.title: Target
entries.description: Check whether the target is explicit or implied.
entries.note: Target: Who is the target?; evidence=Target identity | Power imbalance

entries.title: Relationship
entries.description: A relationship can change the same sentence.
entries.note: Relationship: What is the relationship?; evidence=Role hierarchy | Trust level

entries.title: Intent
entries.description: Intent can turn the same words into different outcomes.
entries.note: Intent: What is the intent?; evidence=Observed action | Scene context

entries.title: Context
entries.description: Dialogue, narration, and documentary framing matter.
entries.note: Context: What is the scene context?; evidence=Neighboring sentences | Scene memory

entries.title: Evidence
entries.note: Evidence: What evidence supports the reading?; evidence=Literal words | Follow-up dialogue

entries.title: Confidence
entries.description: Lower confidence when relationship context is ambiguous.
entries.note: Confidence: How confident are we?; evidence=Corroboration | Contradiction
